decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=/sensor/temp, src=<zero-length PATH> } — a READ that asks for an answer and wires no route for it. Malformed (RFC-0004 Amendment 2): the terminus drops it and emits no frame.
decoded.note: Not a reject.bin case: the frame decodes, and only a terminus can tell a READ from a WRITE. See description.md.
